reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact material (W-Cu composite), intervention (0.8 wt.% Cu@Gr via SPS), mechanism (continuous Cu network, sintering activation), and predicted outcome (~24% thermal conductivity enhancement) already reported as a result in P2, P5, P6, and P7.
